notesHint: Wait for the fan before you speak. The count of pages is the point.
description_en: Proof scene: three to eight pages fly in from off-stage, settle into a fan, then file away together.
description_ko: 증거 장면. 화면 밖에서 페이지 3~8장이 날아들어 부채꼴로 정리된 뒤 한 벌로 빠져나간다.
responsive: On narrow screens, tighten the image fan; with reduced motion, put pages into a static three-column grid.
reducedMotion: Show the page set in a static grid instead of scattering and fanning it.
